business_problem: Kapiche needed to turn massive volumes of customer feedback into structured intelligence, handle highly variable enterprise workloads, and keep the analytics platform secure and reliable without building heavy operations machinery from scratch.
solution_summary: Kapiche built its AI feedback-analysis platform on a cloud-native Google Cloud stack anchored by GKE and Vertex AI. The company processes millions of customer feedback points each day, using Vertex AI and Gemini 2.5 Flash to enrich raw conversations into structured signals such as churn risk, product pain points, and emotion. GKE provides the multi-region ML runtime that can absorb 10x traffic spikes, while Cloud Build, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud SQL support deployment, routing, storage, and observability around the core NLP pipeline. Security Command Center, VPC Service Controls, Cloud DNS, and third-party tooling give the team continuous asset discovery and strong automated posture management. This foundation lets Kapiche deliver real-time prediction and intervention features while keeping infrastructure management overhead low and uptime high for enterprise customers.
